Definition: to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to gather, receive, remove, gather in; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to gather, collect; 1a2) to gather (an individual into company of others); 1a3) to bring up the rear; 1a4) to gather and take away, remove, withdraw; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to assemble, be gathered; 1b2) (pass of Qal 1a2); 1b2a) to be gathered to one's fathers; 1b2b) to be brought in or into (association with others); 1b3) (pass of Qal 1a4); 1b3a) to be taken away, removed, perish; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to gather (harvest); 1c2) to take in, receive into; 1c3) rearguard, rearward (subst); 1d) (Pual) to be gathered; 1e) (Hithpael) to gather oneself or themselves
